<div class="section-intro">
A curated directory of external data sources that students and collaborators can use in fisheries science, marine ecology, oceanography, stock assessment, species-distribution modelling, climate analysis, and reproducible scientific computing.
</div>

**These are not my datasets.** This website does not claim ownership of, mirror, or redistribute the listed data. Each record points to the authoritative provider and summarizes practical access conditions so users can find an appropriate source quickly.

{{< include _generated.md >}}

## Catalogue maintenance

`data/registry.json` is the website's curated source registry. It records only discovery metadata: provider, access model, coverage, formats, intended use, licence/access notes, and the authoritative URL. Dataset files remain with the original provider.

A source is included because it is useful for research or teaching, not because it is endorsed, unrestricted, or interchangeable with another product. Users should always verify the current provider documentation before analysis.
